rationale: The valise was stolen from the luggage rack while the customer was on the platform buying water, so it was unattended. Under section 5 of the policy wording (Baggage and Personal Effects) we do not pay for belongings left unattended, and section 7 of the claims manual confirms that a bag on a train rack is unattended when the customer is on the platform, so the whole claim is excluded. The loss was otherwise within the covered trip and reported to police in time, and the manuscript and drive are excluded in any case for the value of the work they held under section 5.
